chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"Do not cross Wadi Muhassir until the sun rises."
As for the Imam, it is appropriate for him to remain stationed until after the sun has risen. He narrated that.

key_terms.وَادِيَ مُحَسِّرٍ: Wadi Muhassir, a valley between Mina and Muzdalifah

ai.seo_question: When should pilgrims cross Wadi Muhassir during Hajj according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the Sunnah of delaying the departure from Mina to Muzdalifah until after sunrise, a practice specifically emphasized for the Imam to demonstrate leadership in ritual precision. Historically, this ruling highlights the distinction between the general concession for the masses and the exemplary conduct of the Prophet and Imams, reinforcing the importance of timing in Hajj rituals as recorded by Shaykh al-Tusi.
